No transformed source-value character wrapping or canonical LIST record splitting.
Trusted same-render PNGs are byte-bound; source Markdown and all PNGs rechecked before/after export.

Only print metadata raw-splices may change ZIP XML, with nonprinting payload/local records exact proof.
mustPrecedeActualAuthoring: Root must finalize document count and execute exactly one NEW-run native Artifact marker; old pilot marker11 must not repeat.
Pin actual source-only snapshot, final Markdown, safe render receipts, renderer/runtime and exact binding/model SHA.
Validate dependency receipt full inventory and actual loaded paths before/after parsing; never add input to PYTHONPATH.
actualQualificationPending: Actual Artifact export and read-only literal/type/blank/order/merge/frame/width/image verification.
Validate actual package with print helper zip_index then readonly verifier; verifier API itself has no file-path gate.
Print-only plan must bind exact author receipt/workbook/sheet ordinal/name/headerRow/lastRow/actual LIST column count.
Native full-size all ranges and, if necessary, owned read-only Excel actual bitmap QA.
Actual A4 landscape fit-width1 legibility for62-column grids; no success assumed from setting alone.
PDF may independently preserve safe canonical HTML and full literal/order/image coverage; actual all-page visual QA required.
Only root can adopt/publish to agents/reverse-agent/output after all document-specific gates.
limitations: Checks do not make filesystem check/use atomic or prove absence of races.
Caller output ownership and marker acknowledgement are declarations until independently bound by root.
Bundled transitive runtime FS remains its original trusted boundary; no internal introspection.
Prepared code/synthetic PASS is not a quality score or actual delivery approval.
Old ASP.NET deadline and records remain separate; no old post-deadline work is counted toward its12h.
